embeds.title: BLHA WEEKLY RECAP
embeds.description: The results of every completed matchup, posted after each fantasy week ends, normally on Monday morning.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: Completed matchup results for the week • Weekly Awards (the three stars, tough luck, lucky win, closest game, biggest blowout) • Power Rankings • All-play records

fields.name: POWER RANKINGS
fields.value: Results only: 50% season points, 30% points over the last three Weeks, 20% all-play record. All-play is each team's record if it had played every other team every Week.

fields.name: OFFICIAL RESULTS
fields.value: Results are pulled directly from Fantrax. Questions about a score go to the Commissioner's Office.

fields.name: DISCUSSION
fields.value: Owners can react here but not post. Talk about it in **gm-lounge** or **chirps-and-memes**.
